scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.qa:a11y: axe http://localhost:5173/app/dashboard http://localhost:5173/app/learn http://localhost:5173/app/practice http://localhost:5173/app/search --exit --tags wcag2a,wcag2aa
scripts.qa:tokens: rg -q "#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}" src --glob "!**/tokens*" --glob "!**/*.svg" && echo "FAIL: hardcoded hex outside tokens" && exit 1 || echo "OK: no stray hex"
scripts.qa:arbitrary: rg -q "text-\[|p-\[|gap-\[|rounded-\[|duration-\[" src && echo "FAIL: arbitrary Tailwind values remain" && exit 1 || echo "OK: no arbitrary values"
scripts.qa: npm run qa:tokens && npm run qa:arbitrary && npm run qa:antipattern
